y-m-37-01.title: Ukuhlola isisombululo esifumene imeko yokuba neengcambu zenyani
y-m-37-01.topic: Imeko yeengcambu zenyani zolingano olunekoyifishenti enonobumba: ingqikelelo yokuba lulingano lwe-quadratic
y-m-37-01.goal: Yazi ukuba kulingano olunonobumba kwikoyifishenti, uhlobo lwebinzana lunokutshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lonobumba, uze ulungise uluhlu lwesigqibo ukuze luhambelane nemeko kwisivakalisi sengxaki.
y-m-37-01.material: UMinjae wacombulula ingxaki elandelayo. "Fumana uluhlu lwamaxabiso ka-k apho ulingano lwe-quadratic kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 (k linani lenyani) lunengcambu zenyani." (Indlela yokufunda: k amaxesha x isikwere, ukhuphe 4x, udibanise 1 lilingana no-0.) Ingcambu yenyani kuthetha ingcambu elinani lenyani. Jonga isisombululo sikaMinjae umgca omnye ngexesha.
y-m-37-01.thinking.1: Gweba ukuba impendulo itshintsha njani xa imeko yengxaki itshintsha
y-m-37-01.thinking.2: Fumana uze uhlole iimeko zomda ngokwakho
y-m-37-01.prereq.0: I-H3 yalo msebenzi yohlulo lobunzima kuphela kwinqanaba lemveliso; ayithethi ukuba lo mxholo unikwa naliphi na ibanga. Cinga ngomfundi osele efunde umxholo ongezantsi.
y-m-37-01.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-discriminant yolingano lwe-quadratic nenani leengcambu zenyani
y-m-37-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye owenza isigqibo sikaMinjae sinzima ukusithemba njengoko sinjalo. Funda kwakhona isivakalisi sengxaki uze uhlole umgca omnye ngexesha.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana amagama akwisivakalisi sokuqala sengxaki anika igama lohlobo lolingano, uze uhlole ukuba onke amaxabiso ka-k ahlangabezana naloo meko ayabonakaliswa kwisigqibo.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha elona nani lilula eliphelele phakathi kwamaxabiso ka-k abandakanyiweyo kwisigqibo, lifake kwibinzana, uze uthi libinzana lohlobo luni.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukuze ulingano lwe-quadratic kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 lube neengcambu zenyani, i-discriminant kufuneka yanelise D ≥ 0.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.explain: Ingxaki yathi kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 "lulingano lwe-quadratic." Ukuze ibe lulingano lwe-quadratic, ikoyifishenti k ye-x² akufuneki ibe ngu-0. Umgca 1 waqala ukusebenzisa i-discriminant ngaphandle kokuhlola le meko, kwaye isigqibo k ≤ 4 komgca 4 sibandakanya k = 0. Ukubala komgca 2 nomgca 3 kuchanekile. Impendulo echanekileyo yi-k ≤ 4 no-k ≠ 0. Nokuba ukhethe umgca 1 okanye umgca 4, inqaku elibalulekileyo livela kwindawo enye.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.prompt: Ukuba amagama athi "ulingano lwe-quadratic" ashiywa engxakini yaza yabuza "uluhlu luka-k apho ulingano kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 lunengcambu zenyani," impendulo ibiya kuba yintoni?
y-m-37-01.s.s2.hint.0: Faka k = 0 no-k = 4 kwibinzana uze ufumane izisombululo ngokwakho.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.hint.1: Phawula ukuba ukhetho ngalunye luvumela k = 0 okanye hayi, uze uthelekise nezisombululo ozifumene ngokwakho.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.a: k < 4. Ukuba i-discriminant ingu-0, kukho ingcambu ephindiweyo, ngoko iyasuswa.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.a: Ukuba D = 0, kukho ingcambu yenyani enye, ingcambu ephindiweyo. "Inengcambu yenyani" ibandakanya nengcambu ephindiweyo.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.b: k ≤ 4 no-k ≠ 0. Ukuba k = 0, akulona ibinzana le-quadratic, ngoko akukho sisombululo.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.b: Ukuba k = 0, iba −4x + 1 = 0 kwaye kukho ingcambu yenyani x = 1/4. Ukungabi libinzana le-quadratic akuthethi ukuba akukho sisombululo.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.c: k ≤ 4. Kukho ingcambu yenyani xa k = 0 nayo.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.d: k ≥ 4. Khetha icala apho i-discriminant ingu-0 okanye ngaphezulu.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.d: Phinda uhlole icala lophawu lokungalingani xa usombulula D = 16 − 4k ≥ 0 ukufumana k. Umzekelo, faka k = 0 no-k = 5 uthelekise ukuba ikho ngokwenene ingcambu yokwenyani.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.explain: Ukuba kuthi kuphela "inkcazelo," k = 0 nayo lixabiso eliyavunyelwa. Ukuba k = 0, ngoko −4x + 1 = 0 kwaye ikho ingcambu yokwenyani x = 1/4, ngoko uluhlu lwe-k yi-k ≤ 4 (kuquka u-0). Nokuba isisombululo sifanayo, isigqibo sinokwahluka ngokuxhomekeke kumeko ekubhalweni kwengxaki (ukuba yinkcazelo yesibini okanye hayi).
y-m-37-01.s.s3.prompt: Fumana amaxabiso amabini ahlukeneyo e-k apho inkcazelo kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 (ngeli xesha ayifuni ukuba yinkcazelo yesibini) inengcambu enye eyahlukileyo yokwenyani ncam.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala bhala imeko yokuba nengcambu enye yokwenyani ncam xa umlinganiselo we-x² ungeyi-0.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala intetho yemeko apho umlinganiselo we-x² yi-0 ubale ukuba inezisombululo ezingaphi.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.ok.c1: Kule k, inkcazelo inengcambu enye yokwenyani ncam.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Kule k, bala ukuba inkcazelo inengcambu ezingaphi ezahlukeneyo zokwenyani. Bala ngokwahlula ukuba umlinganiselo we-x² yi-0 okanye hayi.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.explain: Ukuba k = 4, ngoko 4x² − 4x + 1 = (2x − 1)², ngoko kukho x = 1/2 kuphela, kwaye ukuba k = 0, ngoko −4x + 1 = 0, ngoko kukho x = 1/4 kuphela. K = 4 apho idiskrimineyiti yi-0 ayonelanga yodwa; kufuneka ujonge ngokwahlukileyo no-k = 0, apho uhlobo lwentetho lutshintsha.

y-m-37-07.title: Ingaba izisombululo ezifunyenwe nguSua zizo zonke?
y-m-37-07.topic: Uluhlu apho ukhetha abagqatswa xa ufumana izisombululo zolingano lwekhyubhu, nesiseko sesigqibo
y-m-37-07.goal: Yazi ukuba ulingano lwekhyubhu olunemilinganiselo yamanani aphelele lunokuba nezisombululo ezingengomanani aphelele, uze ucacise ngokufanelekileyo kumhlobo isizathu sokuba inani lezisombululo owazifumeneyo lodwa lingakuvumeli uthi "ndizifumene zonke."
y-m-37-07.material: USua wasombulula ingxaki yokufumana zonke izisombululo eziyi-real zolingano lwekhyubhu 2x³ − x² − 7x + 6 = 0 (Indlela yokufunda: 2 x ikhyubhu ukususa x isikwere ukususa 7 x kunye 6 kulingana no-0) ngolu hlobo.
y-m-37-07.thinking.1: Fumana uze uhlole wena isisombululo esiphoswe

y-m-37-07.prereq.2: Ukubhala ibinzana lekhyubhu njengesiphumo sebinzana lomgca nebinzana le-quadratic
y-m-37-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye kwisisombululo sikaSua onzima ukuwuthemba. Hlola ngokwahlukileyo ukuba ukubala kumgca ngamnye kulunge na kunye nokuba ingqiqo ilunge na.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.hint.0: Phinda ubale ukufaka kwimigca yesi-2 neyesi-3 wena uze uhlole ukuba amaxabiso alunge na.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca wesi-4, sebenza ukuba "ubuninzi obungu-3" no "ezi zimbini kuphela" zithetha into enye na. Umzekelo, kwi-(x − 1)(x − 2)(x − 3) = 0, kwenzeka ntoni ukuba ufumana izisombululo ezimbini kuphela uze umise?
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.0: Ukuba zikho izisombululo, ziphakathi kwabahlukanisi belungu eliqhubekayo 6, ±1, ±2, ±3, ±6, ngoko sivavanya ezi-8 kuphela.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.1: x = 1: 2 − 1 − 7 + 6 = 0, ngoko sisisombululo. x = −2: −16 − 4 + 14 + 6 = 0, ngoko sisisombululo.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.2: Abagqatswa abasalayo ±3, ±6, 2, −1 bonke abango-0 xa kufakwa.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.3: Ulingano lwekhyubhu lunezisombululo ezi-3 ubuninzi yaye sifumene ezi-2, ngoko izisombululo zi-x = 1 no-x = −2 kuphela.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.explain: Umgca wo-1: kuphela xa isisombululo linani eliphelele siphakathi kwabahlukanisi belungu eliqhubekayo. Ukuba umlinganiselo ophambili u-2, isisombululo seqhezu elinje nge-3/2 sinokwenzeka nasona. Umgca wesi-4: "ubuninzi obungu-3" kuthetha ukuba kunokubakho ukuya kuthi ga kwezi-3, ngoko ukufumana ezi-2 asisosizathu sokuthi akukho ezinye. Ukubala kwimigca yesi-2 neyesi-3 kulunge.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.prompt: Fumana isisombululo sesithathu esiyi-real esiphoswe nguSua uze usifake njengedesimali. (Sibhale njengedesimali, njenge-0.5, umzekelo.)
y-m-37-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuba inyaniso yokuba izisombululo x = 1 no-x = −2 ziyaziwa ibeka sithintelo sini kwimo yebinzana lekhyubhu.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala eso sithintelo, ufumane ukuba lisaleyo ibinzana elilula elinjani, uze ufake i-x eyenza elo binzana libe ngu-0 kulingano lokuqala ukuhlola.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Ukuba ufaka eli xabiso, ibinzana liba ngu-0.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Faka ixabiso owalifake kwibinzana uze ubale wena ukuba liba ngu-0 na.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Kufuneka ufumane ixabiso elingelilo lalawo ezisombululo esele zifunyenwe nguSua (1 no-−2).
y-m-37-07.s.s2.explain: Ukuba ufaka x = 3/2 = 1.5, ngoko 2·(27/8) − 9/4 − 21/2 + 6 = 0. Ulingano lunokubhalwa njenge-(x − 1)(x + 2)(2x − 3) = 0, ngoko kukho izisombululo ezintathu, 1, −2, 3/2. 3/2 ayingomhlukanisi we-6.

y-m-37-05.title: Ukujonga ingxelo ethi "ukuba igrafu ayidibani ne-x-axis, ihlala ibamba"
y-m-37-05.topic: Imeko yokuba ukungalingani kwesibini kuhlale kubamba: idiskrimineyiti nomlinganiselo ophambili
y-m-37-05.goal: Bonisa ngemizekelo echasayo ukuba ukuze ukungalingani kwesibini kubambe kuwo onke amanani okwenyani imeko yediskrimineyiti yodwa ayonelanga kwaye uphawu lomlinganiselo ophambili luyafuneka, uze uthi umda (D = 0) uthetha ntoni.
y-m-37-05.material: USoyoung ushwankathele ngolu hlobo: "Kokungalingani kwesibini ax² + bx + c > 0 (a ≠ 0, a, b, c ngamanani okwenyani), ukuba idiskrimineyiti D = b² − 4ac ingaphantsi kwe-0, oku kungalingani kubamba kuwo onke amanani okwenyani x." (Indlela yokuyifunda: a x isikwere kunye no-b x kunye no-c likhulu kune-0.)

y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.a: Ihlala ichanekile njengoko injalo. Ukuba D < 0, ipharabola ayidibani ne-x-axis.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.a: Kuyinyaniso ukuba ipharabola ayidibani ne-x-axis, kodwa ukuba ipharabola ingaphezulu okanye ingaphantsi kwe-x-axis yinto eyahlukileyo.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.b: Ukuba D < 0, ayisebenzi kuyo nayiphi na x.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.b: Cinga ngomzekelo one-a > 0, x² + 1 > 0. D = −4, kodwa isebenza kuyo yonke i-x.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.c: Awukwazi ukwazi ukuba ilunge ide ufake amanani kwi-a, b, c.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.c: Ukufaka amanani yindlela elungileyo nayo, kodwa ukuba ucinga ngemo yepharabholi, ungagweba ngaphandle kwamanani.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.d: Ukuba a ibi, ayisebenzi, ngoko ayilunganga njengoko injalo.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.explain: Ukuba D < 0, ipharabholi y = ax² + bx + c ayidibani ne-x-axis. Kodwa ukuba a < 0, ipharabholi ingaphantsi kwe-x-axis kuphela, ngoko ukungalingani akusebenzi kuyo nayiphi na x. Umzekelo, −x² − 1 > 0 ayinayo x apho isebenza khona (D = −4 < 0).
y-m-37-05.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izibini ezintathu zamanani aphelele (a, b, c) zeentlobo ezahlukeneyo apho i-discriminant D = b² − 4ac ingu-0 okanye ngaphantsi, kodwa ax² + bx + c > 0 ayisebenzi kuzo zonke iinani eziyi-real x. Iintlobo: zintlobo ezahlukeneyo ukuba uphawu luka-a luyahluka, okanye ukuba D ingu-0 okanye hayi iyahluka.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale indlela imo yepharabholi eyahluka ngayo xa a ingqina nexa a ibi, nokuba idibana ne-x-axis kumachaphazelo amangaphi xa D ingu-0.

y-m-37-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Bala D = b² − 4ac. Kufuneka ibe ngu-0 okanye ngaphantsi.

y-m-37-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Ukuba a > 0 no-D < 0, isebenza kuyo yonke x. Kufuneka wenze umzekelo one-x apho ingasebenzi khona. Cinga ngemo evulekileyo ngaphezulu okanye ngezantsi nendawo ngokuthelekiswa ne-x-axis.

y-m-37-08.topic: Inani lezisombululo zamanani aphelele zenkqubo yokungalingani nokuba ixabiso lomda libandakanyiwe na
y-m-37-08.goal: Yazi ukuba xa inani lezisombululo zamanani aphelele zenkqubo yokungalingani limiselwe, ipharamitha inokuba namaxabiso amaninzi, uze ugweba ngokuhlola ngokuthe ngqo ukuba ixabiso lomda libandakanyiwe na.
y-m-37-08.material: Cinga inkqubo yokungalingani { x² − x − 6 < 0, x > a } (a linani leqinisileyo). Isisombululo sokungalingani kokuqala yi-−2 < x < 3. (Indlela yokufunda: x isikwere ukususa x ukususa 6 incinci kuno-0, kwaye ngaxeshanye x likhulu kuno-a.) Inani lamanani aphelele x ahlangabezana nokungalingani kwamabini litshintsha ngo-a.

y-m-37-08.s.s1.hint.1: Gcina kuphela ezo zanelisa x > 0, kodwa hlola ukuba i-0 ngokwayo isala na.

y-m-37-02.goal: Yazi ukuba ukuthi "enye ingcambu yinani elintsonkothileyo elihambelanayo" kwinkcazelo yesibini enengcambu entsonkothileyo enikiweyo, kufuneka imeko yemilinganiselo, uze wenze wena ezinye iindlela ezinokwenzeka xa imeko ilahlekile.
y-m-37-02.material: Enye yeengcambu zenkcazelo yesibini x² + px + q = 0 yi-1 + 2i. (i yiyunithi engeyonyani apho i² = −1. Indlela yokuyifunda: x isikwere kunye no-p x kunye no-q lilingana ne-0.) UHyunjun wathi, "Ngoko enye ingcambu yi-1 − 2i, ngoko sinokufumana p no-q."

y-m-37-02.s.s1.prompt: Njengoko uHyunjun esitsho, ukufumana p no-q kufuneka ulwazi olongezelelweyo olungekho kwingxelo. Khetha zonke ezilandelayo apho ukongeza nje ulwazi olunye kulungisa p no-q nganye kwixabiso elinye.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinketho nganye, biza enye ingcambu ngokuthi r, ubhale iimeko ekufuneka 1 + 2i no-r ziyanelise.

y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.a: Ngokuba nje p linani eliphelele, amaxabiso amaninzi ayenzeka, njenge-p = 0, p = 1, njalo njalo. Umzekelo, ukuba p = 0, enye ingcambu yi-−1 − 2i, eyahlukileyo kwimeko ka-p = −2.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba yingcambu ephindiweyo, zombini iingcambu zigqitywa njenge-1 + 2i, ngoko p no-q nazo ziyagqitywa. Akunamsebenzi ukuba imilinganiselo iba ngamanani antsonkothileyo.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba p no-q zezokwenyani, enye ingcambu linani elintsonkothileyo elihambelanayo ukuze iinxalenye ezingeyonyani zirhoxiswe, kwaye p no-q ziyagqitywa.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.d: Ukwazi kuphela ukuba q yeyokwenyani akugqibi enye ingcambu. Umzekelo, ukuba enye ingcambu yi-2 − 4i, ngoko q = 10 yeyokwenyani, kodwa p = −3 + 2i ayiyiyo yokwenyani.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuba p no-q zombini zezokwenyani, enye ingcambu igqitywa njenge-1 − 2i, kwaye p = −2, q = 5. Ukuba yingcambu ephindiweyo, zombini iingcambu zi-1 + 2i, ngoko p = −2 − 4i no-q = −3 + 4i ziyagqitywa, kodwa imilinganiselo ayiyiyo yokwenyani. Ulwazi lokuba p linani eliphelele okanye q yeyokwenyani alugqibi enye ingcambu ibe yinye. Ungagweba ukuba ulwazi lwanele ngokubuza, "Ingaba ikho ngokwenene ingcambu enye kuphela eseleyo enelisa olu lwazi?"
y-m-37-02.s.s2.prompt: Ngoku cinga ukuba p no-q zombini ngamanani okwenyani. Khetha umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo apho uHyunjun wafumana p no-q.

y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.b: a = 1 lixabiso olikhethe ngokungenasizathu. Ingxaki ayinalo ulwazi lokuba a = 1, yaye ayihambelani nemeko yokuba isisombululo siphakathi kweengcambu ezimbini.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.c: Inyaniso yokuba isisombululo siphakathi kweengcambu ezimbini ithetha ukuba ipharabholi inemo ye-∩ (ivuleka ngezantsi), ngoko ungaxela uphawu luka-a.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.d: Ayimiselwanga. a < 0, kodwa ubukhulu bunokwenzeka ngeendlela ezininzi.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.explain: Iingcambu ezimbini zi-−1 neyesi-3 yaye isisombululo siphakathi kweengcambu ezimbini, ngoko a < 0. Inefom a(x + 1)(x − 3) > 0, ngoko −x² + 2x + 3 > 0, −2x² + 4x + 6 > 0, ... , yaye kukho amabinzana angenasiphelo anokwenzeka.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.prompt: Fumana izibini ezintathu zamanani aphelele ezahlukeneyo (a, b, c) ezenza ukungalingani kwe-quadratic ax² + bx + c > 0 kunesisombululo kanye −1 < x < 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala iimlinganiselo ezimbini ku-a, b, c ezenza ibinzana libe ngu-0 xa ufaka x = −1 no-x = 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-b, c oyifumeneyo no-a, yenza imizekelo ngokutshintsha ixabiso luka-a, uze uhlole uphawu luka-a.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Ixabiso ofumana xa ufaka x = −1 kwi-ax² + bx + c kufuneka libe ngu-0. Okwangoku ayingo-0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Ixabiso ofumana xa ufaka x = 3 kwi-ax² + bx + c kufuneka libe ngu-0. Okwangoku ayingo-0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Imo injalo ukuba isisombululo sisithuba esiphakathi kweengcambu ezimbini.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c4: Jonga uphawu luka-a kwakhona. Ukuze isisombululo sibe sisithuba esiphakathi kweengcambu ezimbini, ipharabholi kufuneka ibe nemo enjani?
y-m-37-06.s.s2.explain: Nasiphi na isibini samanani aphelele esine-b = −2a, c = −3a kunye ne-a < 0, njenge-(−1, 2, 3), (−2, 4, 6), (−3, 6, 9), sinesisombululo −1 < x < 3. Ziibinzana ezilinganayo, ngoko izisombululo ziyafana.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba wongeza enye yezi zilandelayo kulwazi lokuba isisombululo yi-−1 < x < 3, ngoko (a, b, c) imiselwe ibe yimpendulo enye. Yeyiphi?
y-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kwimizekelo emithathu oyenzileyo ngaphambili, hlola ukuba ulwazi lukhetho ngalunye seluyasebenza kuzo zonke.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ukuba ulwazi seluyasebenza kumzekelo ngamnye, asilulwazi olutsha. Fumana ukhetho apho lungenjalo.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.a: Xa x = 0, ixabiso le-ax² + bx + c li-3.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.b: I-axis yokulingana yomsebenzi we-quadratic y = ax² + bx + c yi-x = 1.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.b: Ukuba isisombululo yi-−1 < x < 3, indawo ephakathi yeengcambu ezimbini sele yi-x = 1. Uphinde ulwazi esele lubandakanyiwe.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.c: Iingcambu ezimbini zolingano ax² + bx + c = 0 zi-−1 neyesi-3.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.c: Ukuba kukungalingani kwesisombululo −1 < x < 3, sele ungaxela ukuba iingcambu zolingano zi-−1 neyesi-3. Asilulwazi olutsha.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.d: a, b, c zonke ngamanani aphelele.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.d: Le yimeko esele inikiwe, yaye zikho amabinzana amaninzi anemilinganiselo yamanani aphelele, njenge-(−1, 2, 3), (−2, 4, 6).
y-m-37-06.s.s3.explain: Ixabiso kwi-x = 0 yi-c. Ukuba c = 3, ngoko ukusuka ku-c = −3a sifumana a = −1, yaye b = 2 imiselwe. Ukhetho olusele ziintlobo ongaxela sele ngesisombululo −1 < x < 3, ngoko asilulwazi olutsha. Indlela yokukhetha ukuba ulwazi lutsha: hlola ukuba amabinzana amaninzi ahlukeneyo anelisa olo lwazi asasele na.
